info.name: Comtanix Quote Request Manager - Technical Review
info.description: Source-aligned Laravel and Node audit requests with four fictional client briefs. Import the accompanying environment and configure local secrets. Run folders in order. ALL saved responses are illustrative and NOT verified against a running API. Sample IDs 201-204 and 1/2/3, timestamps, UUIDs, counts, and pagination URLs are examples only. Real IDs and tokens are captured from successful responses. Client addresses use test.com; seeded logins preserve comtanix.test to match StaffUserSeeder. All secret variables are blank. Documentation generation and local validation do not modify database records or seeders. Sending the workflow creates four quotes, issues tokens, and manages Saim's captured quote. Direct audit writes and deletion are skipped by default. See docs/postman/README.md for setup, validation, roles, and verification scope.

Skipped unless enable_direct_audit_writes=true. Inserts a synthetic audit document without changing the Laravel quote. Metadata matches its publisher. Generates one UUID and timestamp per send; HMAC-SHA256 signs the exact resolved UTF-8 body. receivedAt is server-generated and cannot appear in the strict input schema.

exec: throw new Error('Missing environment variable; configure it or run its prerequisite: ' + key);
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', encoder.encode(pm.environment.get('audit_shared_secret')), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, encoder.encode(body));
const hex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature), byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
